senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (लञ्जयति)
1 To be manifest.
2 To shine.

m. (-ञ्जः)
1 A foot.
2 The end of the lower garment tucked into the waist band.
3 A tail.
f. (-ञ्जा)
1 An adulteress.
2 Sleep.
3 LAKṢMĪ.
4 A current.
E.
लजि to be strong, &c., aff. अच्.

f. (-का)
A harlot, a whore.
E.
लजि to censure, aff. क्वुन्, fem. form.

n. (-नं)
1 A name, an appellation.
2 A mark or sign.
E.
लाच्छि to mark, aff. ल्युट्.
